messages:
sara: Citrine Labs cutover reminder — Dedicated -> Private migration planned Tue 2026-04-14 22:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go, version pin, and rollback thresholds by EOD.
ken: Quick Q — are we pinning runtime v3.4.1 (stable) or canary v3.5-rc for the new scheduling path?
sara: Pin stable v3.4.1 for the main rollout. We can run a canary on v3.5-rc for 5% of traffic for 30m only if infra metrics look clean.
lia: Citrine ops asked to avoid 02:00-04:00 CET. 22:00 UTC is fine on their side :thumbsup:
paul: Required SLOs to watch during canary: p95 latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.6%, cpu pod > 60% alerts suppressed for autoscaling ramp.
marta: Approve window and pin v3.4.1? I need explicit rollback trigger definition before I sign off.
sara: Yes — approve window. Rollback triggers: sustained error rate >= 1% for 5m OR p95 latency > 220ms for 5m. Manual abort allowed anytime by oncall.
paul: I'll add automated alarm and runbook links to the rollout doc.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued at 1945672620 for citrine/canary-traffic (20 reqs/min).
sara: Canary duration 30m, then 10m cooldown. If canary passes, we increment to 25% for 15m, then full ramp.
ken: If we need immediate rollback, use the command below (will re-route and pin older model):
```bash
rw-deploy rollback --customer citrine --target-version v3.4.0 --reason "post-cutover regressions"
```
This will trigger traffic re-route within ~45s.
lia: I'll notify Citrine's lead SRE and schedule the post-cutover sync at +24h.
marta: Sign-off pending one more check: can we guarantee KV cache warmup won’t spike tokens/cost? Any mitigations?
paul: Mitigation: progressive prefix warming and KV cache pre-warm job scheduled - will run 10m before start. Also auto-burst disabled for first 10m.
sara: All set then. marta, consider this formal sign-off unless you flag.
marta: Signed-off. I'll post release notes to Citrine and add rollback playbook to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary finished at 1945672640 — metrics: p95=58ms, errors=0.2%, cpu avg 42% — canary PASS.
paul: Kicking full ramp now. Monitoring dashboards pinned to the thread.
sara: Thanks team — I'll update the customer and close the change window after +1h observation.
deploy-bot: Full rollforward completed at 1945672650. No rollback triggered.
